articles.title: Bitcoin, ether traders aren't fully buying the bounce, options markets show
Binance says MiCA should be judged by who it licenses, not who it excludes
articles.snippet: Europe head Gillian Lynch said Binance met Greece's licensing requirements and that the company remains committed to the EU, despite withdrawing its MiCA application days before the July 1 deadline.

articles.title: SBI Crypto to shut down mining pool that holds roughly 2% of Bitcoin's hashrate
articles.snippet: Miners must redirect their hashrate before the July 31 cutoff, as the pool will stop accepting contributions after that date.

articles.title: A struggling Nasdaq-listed company that tried to copy Saylor's Bitcoin playbook is completely dumping crypto for AI
articles.snippet: The Nasdaq-listed Korean media company once lined up $1 billion in financing to buy 10,000 bitcoin. A recent filing confirms its balance is now zero as it pivots to AI infrastructure and fights to stay listed.

articles.title: Three years after MiCA became law, Europe's crypto framework is undergoing a rethink
articles.snippet: Europe’s MiCA regime is now up for review, known colloquially as “MiCA 2.0,” through a consultation that closes around September.
